title: linaria multicaulis var. diffusa
intro: Linaria multicaulis var. diffusa, commonly known as Baby Blue Eyes, is a flowering plant species in the Figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antispasmodic agent. The therapeutic actions of Baby Blue Eyes include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
